snippet.title: Project Space Station - 1985 - C64
snippet.description:
Apparently the crack on this program is worthless: crew options are missing and without that it is not possible to complete a flight plan.
Fortunately I can run the tutorials, and that allows me to look into some of the mechanics.
The game uses detailed screens with an icon based menu system, and it is one of the clear examples on how mature game design became by 1985.
